title: ARI node_report.json
description: Per-BFTS-node self report. Written at mark_success/mark_failed time and consumed by generate_ear, nodes_to_science_data, and bfts.expand.

parent_id.description: Parent node id; null for the root.

ancestor_ids.description: root->parent chain of ancestor node ids.

label.description: BFTS exploration role. NOT inert unless ARI_BFTS_NO_LABEL=1: the label drives the system prompt's NODE ROLE, the child's task line, and node SELECTION (diversity_bonus gives +0.05 to under-represented labels under the default scientific_plus_diversity frontier score). ALWAYS recorded — the former ARI_REPORT_MINIMAL suppression was removed because hiding a live variable from the record leaves its influence and deletes the evidence. Derived deterministically from the direction when ARI_BFTS_DETERMINISTIC_LABEL=1.

raw_label.description: Original LLM-proposed label, kept only when label=='other' (empty for the canonical five). Always recorded.

original_direction.description: Direction text the parent's expand assigned to this child. Always recorded (the ARI_REPORT_MINIMAL suppression was removed).

files_changed.description: Files this node touched relative to its parent. added+modified+deleted==0 marks a sterile (no-op) node.

note.description: Agent's one-line explanation of what this file is.
Agent's one-line explanation of what changed.
Agent's one-line explanation of why it was removed.

what_was_done.description: The agent's own natural-language self-report; filled only when the node concluded (empty for weak models that cannot use tools).

delta_vs_parent.description: Deterministic, verified change vs parent (files touched + measured valid_geomean_speedup); a ground-truth anchor, always present.

metrics.description: Deterministic evaluator measurements (valid_geomean_speedup, _scientific_score, speedup_*, _sterile for no-op nodes, ...).

self_assessment.description: The node's self-assessment. `succeeded` is the deterministic has_real_data ground truth (objective). `headline` and `concerns` come from the agent's own LLM self-review (headline = its summary; concerns = its self-flagged caveats), empty when the agent gave none; under a rubric/judge scorer concerns falls back to the evaluator's low (<0.4) axis rationales. The evaluator's terse reason lives in `evaluator_reason`, not here.

next_steps_hints.description: The agent's own self-reviewed next steps (LLM self-review) — what it would try next. Under deterministic scoring (no graded axes) this is the sole source; falls back to the evaluator's mid-range (0.4-0.7) axis rationales when a rubric/judge scorer is used. Empty when the agent volunteered none.

build_command.description: Build command for the node's artifact (operational scaffold).

run_command.description: Run command for the node's artifact (operational scaffold).

artifacts.description: Artifacts the node produced, with role classification.

trace_log_summary.description: Summary of the node's execution trace.

executor.description: How the node's tool calls executed: 'slurm' | 'local' | 'singularity'. Run-env provenance, populate-as-needed by ari.agent.run_env; omitted when not captured.

hostname.description: Compute host that produced the metrics. Populate-as-needed; omitted when not captured (never auto-captured from the ambient env).

slurm_job_id.description: SLURM job id (populate-as-needed; omitted when not captured).

slurm_partition.description: SLURM partition (populate-as-needed; omitted when not captured).

slurm_nodelist.description: SLURM nodelist (populate-as-needed; omitted when not captured).

cpu_info.description: CPU provenance (populate-as-needed; omitted when not captured).

mem_total_kb.description: Total memory in KB (populate-as-needed; omitted when not captured).

compilers.description: Compiler versions (populate-as-needed; omitted when not captured).
